question: What rejuvenating transformation occurs through six months of dedicated practice?
premises: The practice is performed for six months.
Even an old person becomes youthful.
inference: Six months of dedicated practice rejuvenates even an aged practitioner.
uncertainties: taruṇā (feminine) with vṛddhaḥ (masculine) shows gender variation in the text.
plain_english: Through six months of dedicated practice, even an old person becomes youthful.
